productionCandidate.creator: Thi3d
productionCandidate.notes: Raw source GLB is archived at assets/ds/model/ds-lite.source.glb. The derived production candidate is public/assets/ds/model/ds-lite-crimson.glb: crimson shell recolor, black screen surfaces, source demo text and wrist strap removed, hinge and cartridge anchors normalized, semantic button nodes added, the incomplete Slot-1 source stub removed, and the Slot-2 dust cover retained only as slot2_cover. Full blank cartridges and the stylus are carried by ds-lite-accessories.glb. A clamped Open clip is authored at 650 ms and folds the lid from a true closed-on-bottom pose around the shared hinge axis to a 170-degree visible opening endpoint. Credit Thi3d plus modifications.
